spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  a
 - input  b
 - input  cin
 - output cout
 - output sum

The module should impement a full adder. A full adder adds three bits
(including carry-in) and produces a sum and carry-out.

messages.content:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  a
 - input  b
 - input  cin
 - output cout
 - output sum

The module should impement a full adder. A full adder adds three bits
(including carry-in) and produces a sum and carry-out.

Write the complete SystemVerilog implementation of TopModule.
Respond with a single ```verilog code block containing the full module and nothing else.

content.text:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input  logic a,
    input  logic b,
    input  logic cin,
    output logic cout,
    output logic sum
);

    assign {cout, sum} = a + b + cin;

endmodule
```
